entities.name: Antiochus IV of Commagene
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gaius Julius Antiochus IV Epiphanes, the last king of Commagene, reigned between 38 and 72 as a client king to the Roman Empire. The epithet "Epiphanes" means "the Glorious".
